header.what: CELLxGENE Discover curation index, reduced to the fields docs/PREREGISTRATION_STRATUM_LIST.md uses. Committed as evidence and pinned by sha256 in §2 of that document.
header.fields_dropped_note: Every other field of the upstream record is dropped. assay and tissue are reduced to their labels; the ontology term ids are not retained.
header.self_sha256_note: A file cannot carry its own sha256. The sha256 of THIS reduced file is recorded in §2 of docs/PREREGISTRATION_STRATUM_LIST.md and pinned in scripts/freeze_stratum_list.py, which refuses to run against different bytes. The hash above is of the raw upstream response this file was reduced from.
header.describes: Discover as of the read date. NOT the Census release: the release is pinned to 2025-01-30 and the two indexes are measurably different objects — see release_vs_discover in census_release_datasets_2025-01-30.json.

full_record_scan.scope: every field of every upstream record, before reduction
full_record_scan.note: Run at read time against the payload whose sha256 is above. It is NOT recomputable from this reduced file, and the document labels it as a read-time observation rather than a machine-checked claim.

retained_field_scan.scope: the retained fields of this file
retained_field_scan.note: Recomputable from these bytes; the freeze script recomputes it.
